page.overview:
Who is Paul Clearwater?

Paul Clearwater, better known by his gang name Catsblood Claw, is the leader of the Road Hogs Gang. Catsblood feels a natural sense of superiority to any other creature. He's a natural, charismatic leader who the Road Hogs follow enthusiastically and an expert combat tactician. He's never been bested in personal combat. Not because he's physically superior, but because he uses his mind calmly while he fights. He and his gang pose an ongoing threat to all. He usually carries a sidearm and a couple of daggers. He also wears a heavy chain over the left shoulder.
